description.text: Computer Science and Technology is a comprehensive discipline that studies the design, principles, applications and related technologies of computers. Its core lies in exploring how to solve problems such as information processing, data management, and intelligent interaction through the combination of software and hardware. It is not only a fundamental discipline driving the development of the digital age, but also an interdisciplinary field deeply integrated with various industries. Its application scenarios cover a wide range of fields from daily office work to aerospace engineering, from artificial intelligence to the Internet of Things.Computer System Architecture: Studies the collaborative design of computer hardware (such as chips, memory, processors) and software, focusing on system performance optimization, parallel computing, distributed systems, etc.Computer Software and Theory: Covers programming languages, algorithm design and analysis, operating systems, database principles, etc., addressing the issue of "how to efficiently write and run programs".Computer Application Technology: Focuses on the application scenarios of technologies, such as artificial intelligence (machine learning, natural language processing), big data analysis, computer vision, cybersecurity, Internet of Things, etc.Human-Computer Interaction and Multimedia Technology: Studies the interaction methods between humans and computers (such as gesture recognition, virtual reality) and the processing technologies of multimedia information like audio and video.

duration.text: The Computer science and technology at Shaanxi Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2750 USD/per year ￥ 19800 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Copy of the photo page of the valid passport. If the validity period of the passport is earlier than September 2025, please renew it promptly. 2. Notarized proof of the highest educational attainment. If the applicant is a student or has already started employment, in addition, a pre-graduation certificate issued by the school where the applicant is studying or an on-the-job certificate issued by the employer must be submitted. 3. Original transcript of the previous study stage. 4. Research Achievements. Published papers, award certificates, and other materials that demonstrate academic achievements and research capabilities will be considered. Applicants who have already obtained research results or various awards will be given priority for admission. 5. Study or research program in China. No less than 800 words. 6. Recommendation Letters. Applicants for master's and doctoral programs must provide two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors, and the letters should be signed by the recommenders. 7. Language proficiency certificate. Valid HSK certificate and English proficiency certificate. 8. Certificate of No Criminal Record. It should be a document issued within the past 6 months prior to the submission of the application. 9. Foreigner Physical Examination Form. The validity period of the examination results is 6 months. 10. Applicants under the age of 18 must submit relevant legal documents of their legal guardians in China.

requirements.text: 1. Have the nationality of a country participating in the "Belt and Road Initiative" and hold a valid foreign ordinary passport; 2. Friendly towards China, healthy and physically fit; 3. Have good conduct, abide by laws and regulations, be diligent and eager to learn, and have no violations of Chinese laws and regulations or school rules and regulations. 4. Applicants for doctoral studies should be no older than 40 years; applicants for master's studies should be no older than 35 years; applicants for undergraduate studies should be no older than 30 years; applicants for non-degree Chinese language training in China can be up to 45 years old (age is calculated as of September 1, 2025). 5. No other scholarships were received.
